definitions.explanation: Describes deep affection and tenderness toward someone or something cherished.

examples.japanese: {愛|いと}しい{人|ひと}のために{何|なん}でもする。
examples.english: I would do anything for my beloved.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{寝顔|ねがお}が{愛|いと}しくてたまらない。
examples.english: My child's sleeping face is so precious I can't stand it.
examples.notes: ～てたまらない expresses overwhelming emotion

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}のことを{愛|いと}しく{思|おも}う。

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverbial: {愛|いと}しく
・Noun form: {愛|いと}しさ (dearness, tenderness)

{愛|いと}しい expresses deep, tender affection. It is more poetic and emotional than {大切|たいせつ} or {好|す}き.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{愛|いと}しい{人|ひと} (beloved person)
・{愛|いと}しい{我|わ}が{子|こ} (my dear child)
・{愛|いと}しくてたまらない (unbearably dear)
・{愛|いと}しく{思|おも}う (to hold dear)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{好|す}き: General liking
・{大切|たいせつ}: Important, treasured
・{愛|いと}しい: Deep romantic or parental love
・{可愛|かわい}い: Cute, endearing

REGISTER: Somewhat literary/poetic; used in songs, poetry, and emotional contexts.
